adaptation.reason: The source names a quadrilateral ABCD but its drawn boundary order is ABDC and give s no midpoint condition. Made its intended trapezoid midsegment interpretation explicit, while preserving the source graph and algebraic labels; no inferred midpoint ticks were added.

audit.independent_solution: With S, T the leg midpoints, ST=(AB+CD)/2. Hence 9=((x+4)+(3x+2))/2=2x+3, so x=3 and AB=x+4=7, option C.
audit.geometry_notes: Coordinates were analytically constructed from the stated conditions. Computed lengths freeze a faithful shape without exposing the answer as a label. Display-only coordinates do not add question conditions.
